messages:
Liam (AE): Quick sync FinSys wants BYO HSM (FIPS 140-2), per-key 30d rotation for signing keys, and audit logs shipped to their Splunk instance. They asked for: runbook owner, estimate of delta vs standard hosted API, and a preflight checklist. Can we cover?
Nadia (Solutions Eng): I can lead the runbook. Need to know if they require hardware attestation snapshots at cutover or just vendor-signed attestation artifacts. Also: will they accept short-lived proxy TLS sessions (keepalive) or require per-request TLS?
Liam (AE): They insisted on attestation snapshots at cutover plus continuous attestation heartbeat every 5m. Prefer long-lived TLS with mTLS client certs for performance.
Olga (Security): We can support heartbeat and snapshot. For FIPS/HSM attestations we need vendor ATE-statement + cert chain. Also: escrow/isolation question  do they require split-knowledge for rotation? If yes, that changes SOW (key ceremony).
Jacob (Finance): Ballpark delta: reserved capacity fee + BYO connector surcharge. Create P-QUOTE-876 in pricing UI (https://redwood.example/quotes/P-QUOTE-876) and attach projected QPS/tokens. Rough estimate: +18% infra overhead, connector fee $3k/mo baseline + $0.0018 per proxied request for high reuse.
Nadia (Solutions Eng): Ops notes: For cutover plan I propose steps:
1) Deploy key-proxy in staging with their certs
2) Run attestation snapshot and ship to their SIEM
3) Run traffic split (90/10) for 30m
4) Full cutover in 2h window with 15m fallback to provider-mgr key
Sample handshake command for their engineers:
```
rdwctl byo-start --host hsm.finsys.corp:8443 \
  --client-cert ./client.pem --verify-attestation ./attest.json \
  --heartbeat 300
```
Liam (AE): Nice. Add a checklist item for network egress IP ranges and TLS cipher whitelist. Also they asked about rotation cadence flexibility (30d required for signing, 90d ok for encryption keys).
Olga (Security): We'll draft secq answers: Q7: "Can customer force rotation?" Answer: Yes, for BYO CMKs customer-controlled rotation; Redwood will execute rotation per schedule and can provide attest logs. Q12: "Is key material ever in Redwood SSA?" Answer: No, keystores remain in customer HSM; proxy holds ephemeral session keys only.
DeployBot: New ticket created: BYO-HSM-PRE-FLIGHT-248 (https://redwood.example/t/248)
Jacob (Finance): Please add expected token volume to the quote. If 40M tokens/mo, add ~12% more to connector fee estimate due to TLS churn.
Nadia (Solutions Eng): Ops blocker: multi-region failover. We can do active-active proxy but need vendor replication across regions; that'll add 2-3d to POC and impact cost.
Liam (AE): Action items: Nadia -> full runbook + nginx proxy sample by EOD; Olga -> secq draft + attestation artifact template; Jacob -> finalize P-QUOTE-876 with 2 pricing scenarios (30d rotation SKU, 90d rotation SKU); Liam -> schedule dry-run with FinSys for 2026-05-12 09:00 PT.
Olga (Security): Copying legal on DPA addendum language for BYO KMS.
Nadia (Solutions Eng): I'll also include a small perf test harness to validate long-lived mTLS vs per-request TLS.
Liam (AE): Thanks everyone. Tagging @Nadia @Olga @Jacob. :white_check_mark:
Jacob (Finance): Reminder: attach QPS and token projections to P-QUOTE-876 to lock numbers.
